$comment: INTERFACE.md §7A.7's TIGHTENING, as a fixture both surfaces are pinned to.
'The answer value is the option's label for an object option and the string
itself for a bare-string option; a multi answer is an array of those.' Two
surfaces answer one ask_user question — the web widget (web/src/stream/ask.ts
answerValue) and heph agent's numbered prompt (agent_bridge/cli.py
interactive_answerer) — and before §19.29 they disagreed: the CLI flattened
options with str(o), so an object option arrived at the model as a Python
dict repr while the browser sent the label.
Neither surface can run the other's tests, so this file is the shared
subject: server/tests/test_cli_agent.py types cli_input and asserts the
answerer returns selection; web/test/stream/ask.test.ts makes choice and
asserts answerValue returns the same selection, and asserts affordance
against §7A.7's mapping. A change to one surface's answer namespace fails
the other surface's suite, which is the point.
Hand-written, not recorded: it states what the spec requires, and a
recording of today's behaviour could only state what today's code does.
